decision: Do not claim the design-branch SC catalog/allowlist gate exists on PR38. At pinned PR38 HEAD there is no src/catalog.rs, Showcase coverage.rs/app_tests_catalog.rs, tests/showcase_coverage_allow.txt, or equivalent capability-to-demo inventory gate. Add a crate-aware inventory only as separate planned work; do not copy monolithic src path assumptions. No exception is approved by this review.

capabilities.name: RadioNavigation::Deferred
capabilities.change: New public enum policy and RadioGroup::navigation builder; immediate remains default. Source 804ed9ae1 crates/termrock-controls/src/choice.rs:34-42, 839-840, 928-954; facade export crates/termrock-controls/src/lib.rs and crates/termrock/src/lib.rs changed by same commit.
capabilities.consumer_evidence: Pending public consumer in crates/termrock-forms/tests/form_lanes_consumer.rs:246 and form integration tests; this is an integration test external to termrock-forms' implementation module but still a workspace test, not a separate package consumer. TablePro baseline scenario must retain immediate semantics unless fixed reference proves otherwise.
capabilities.showcase: Do not switch any existing baseline radio to Deferred merely for coverage. If the unchanged baseline Showcase flow only demonstrates default Immediate, Deferred requires a documented SCn exclusion plus a compiled public-consumer interaction test that proves arrows move focus without choosing and Enter/Space chooses. If no existing baseline UI can exercise that policy without changing screens or controls, document that exact reason; do not add a new visible Showcase option.

capabilities.name: visible cursor retention
capabilities.change: New opt-in overlay/menu retained cursor APIs. Source df8831801 crates/termrock-runtime/src/ui/mod.rs:1052-1067, 1069-1137; menu builder crates/termrock-overlays/src/menu.rs:415. Implemented as promotion of a cursor request from a real rendered owner, not synthetic registration.
capabilities.consumer_evidence: The change adds crates/termrock-overlays/tests/visible_terminal_cursor.rs:140-262, covering real terminal/menu, viewport projection, resize/clipping, opt-in frame equality and cursor ownership. Tests are strong contract evidence, but not Showcase adoption evidence.
capabilities.showcase: Retention changes cursor visibility/ownership while an overlay is open. Do not enable it in frozen Showcase flows unless baseline behavior already retains that cursor. If no existing unchanged flow demonstrates the opt-in policy, proposed justified exclusion (not approved): `runtime::Ui::retain_owner_cursor | opt-in focus-owned cursor retention is exercised by visible_terminal_cursor tests; enabling it changes modal/overlay cursor state in the frozen Showcase flow | SCn`; equivalent rows for visible-owner and ContextMenu builder only if registry tracks each public API independently.

capabilities.name: Menu Danger profile
capabilities.change: Behavior/style correction to existing menu-danger profile, not a new consumer API. Source c69a38f9c crates/termrock-theme/src/lib.rs changes disabled palette styling for the existing DANGER variant and labels; commit adds context-menu regression tests.
capabilities.consumer_evidence: Fixed design inventory already lists these IDs at src/catalog.rs:3414 and :4088-4097, and coverage declarations in src/bin/showcase/coverage.rs around :1294-1310 and :4088-4097; existing menus page constructs danger/danger_if entries at src/bin/showcase/pages/menus.rs:52-60. However this is design-branch evidence, not PR38 coverage. PR38 Showcase chrome uses custom menu painting (crates/showcase-demos/src/pages/chrome.rs:217-237), so it is not evidence that the shared menu's danger profile is covered. New regression tests are at crates/termrock-overlays/tests/context_menu_danger_profile.rs (path in commit c69a38f9c).
capabilities.showcase: Do not add a fake capability ID for an existing API/style. Preserve the current shared token/profile behavior and add a focused shared-component visual state assertion if needed. Do not claim Showcase demonstrates it until the shared MenuItem is live in unchanged Showcase UI; no new option or screen.

capabilities.name: CodeEditor Find
capabilities.change: PR38 at pin already exposes CodeCmd::Find and FindAccept/FindBackspace/FindCancel/FindNext in crates/termrock-editors/src/code.rs:124-157, with the Find state/update/render path later in that module. Showcase editor creates CodeEditor at crates/showcase-demos/src/pages/editor.rs:158-164, updates it at :220-239, and advertises `/` Find at :320-336.
capabilities.consumer_evidence: Although the page calls the real CodeEditor for update/draw (`editor.rs:220-239`, :345-346), it takes an early baseline frame branch in draw at :241-244, and custom cursor/marker painting begins at :347. Earlier source audit identifies fixed plate data farther down this same file. Therefore the page is not proof that the live Find visual flow is demonstrated; retain the static baseline behavior only as an unresolved bypass to replace, not move.
capabilities.showcase: Existing API should retain one inventory entry per genuinely new public delta; do not add duplicates if Find is already in the API registry. The editor-live-contract branch currently has no Find-specific API delta. After writer presents exact landed API diff, inventory only new public methods/types. No Showcase coverage declaration until a live page path renders and drives Find without the baseline replay; no new screen/visible control.

design_branch_gate_evidence.registry: src/catalog.rs defines typed Capability and registry; current design source includes existing CodeEditor and menu danger IDs, but grep found no RadioNavigation or retained-cursor API ID.
design_branch_gate_evidence.declarations: src/bin/showcase/coverage.rs has SHOWN entries; Option/StateRow/Demo/Via declarations are screen/option-specific.
design_branch_gate_evidence.allowlist: tests/showcase_coverage_allow.txt parser contract is exactly `id | reason | SCn|permanent`; valid only when reason is explicit, ID exists in registry and is otherwise unshown, and SCn step is linked/valid. It records an exclusion, not demo coverage or product acceptance. This current PR does not contain/use this gate.
design_branch_gate_evidence.automation: design src/bin/showcase/app_tests_catalog.rs scans source and checks missing/duplicate/stale/unknown/unshown entries, allowlist parse and Via consistency. It is a Rust test target; execute via cargo nextest, not cargo test. The PR38 tree has no analogous catalog scanner/test at the pinned head.
